name: @citizen-protocol/nodejs-sdk
description: Node.js SDK for submitting signed CITIZEN protocol envelopes and retrieving deterministic receipts.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && cp dist/esm/index.js dist/index.js && cp dist/cjs/index.js dist/index.cjs && cp dist/esm/index.d.ts dist/index.d.ts && cp dist/esm/index.d.ts.map dist/index.d.ts.map && cp dist/esm/index.js.map dist/index.js.map && cp dist/cjs/index.js.map dist/index.cjs.map
